name: hkb-cli
description: hkb — harness kanban board. A portable, frugal Hermes-style kanban for coding agents; GitHub Issues is the default backend, any harness (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Codex) is a worker.

scripts.lint: for f in bin/hkb.js src/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: if [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit; else echo 'hkb: type check skipped — no local typescript. Run `npm install` first (a devDependency; hkb itself still runs with an empty node_modules).' >&2; fi

author: emyann
